t: You're looking at a statue of David Livingstone, made by the sculptor Thomas Bayliss Huxley-Jones, who created several public works for British towns and cities. Livingstone was a Scottish doctor and pioneer missionary with the London Missionary Society, and an explorer in Africa. He became one of the most popular British heroes of the late Victorian era, remembered as a missionary martyr, a rags-to-riches inspiration, an anti-slavery crusader and an advocate of British commercial and colonial expansion.
